mapper.select: SELECT question_id, exam_id, question_no, question_type, question_text, correct_answer, max_score, grading_criteria, review_required_yn, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM exam_questions WHERE exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY sort_order, question_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_questions (exam_id, question_no, question_type, question_text, correct_answer, max_score, grading_criteria, review_required_yn, sort_order) VALUES (#{examId}, #{questionNo}, #{questionType}, #{questionText}, #{correctAnswer}, #{maxScore}, #{gradingCriteria}, #{reviewRequiredYn}, #{sortOrder})
